name: MindShift CBT
one_liner: Free CBT self-help app for anxiety: thought journal, coping tools, step-by-step fear facing and check-ins. Now run by 247 Labs.
best_for: Adults with everyday worry, social anxiety or panic who want free CBT self-help tools
People in CBT for anxiety who want to practise thought records and exposure between sessions
People who want structured anxiety tools rather than a meditation library
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988 (in Canada, call or text 9-8-8)
People with severe or disabling anxiety who need assessment and treatment from a clinician
People who want an app that works without an account or keeps data only on the phone
short_description: A free app of CBT tools for anxiety, first made by Anxiety Canada and now run by 247 Labs Inc. after Anxiety Canada closed.
long_description: MindShift CBT teaches cognitive behavioural therapy skills for anxiety: a thought journal for challenging anxious thinking, coping statements, step-by-step plans for facing fears, relaxation and mindfulness audio, and mood and anxiety check-ins. It covers general worry, social anxiety, panic, phobias and perfectionism, in English and French. It was built by the non-profit Anxiety Canada, which closed on April 1, 2025 for lack of funding; the app continues under the company 247 Labs Inc., which lists it as free with no subscriptions. You now sign up with an email, name, birth year and country, and the community forum is for adults 18 and over. Research is limited: a 16-week open-label study of 380 adults found moderate improvements in anxiety and depression with no comparison group, and a small randomized feasibility trial tested it with psychiatric inpatients.
patient_summary: MindShift CBT gives you CBT tools for anxiety, such as a thought journal, coping statements and step-by-step plans for facing fears. It is free to download and use, but you need to create an account. It was made by Anxiety Canada and is now run by a company, 247 Labs, so read its current privacy policy before you share details.

pricing.notes: Free to download and use with no subscriptions, per the store listing and developer site. Requires a free account.

privacy.notes: Policy (read 2026-10-27) says MindShift CBT does not sell your information or use check-in data for advertising, and shares data only with service providers such as Mixpanel analytics (which receives name, email and mood data); you can delete your account and data at any time.

seo.title: MindShift CBT: Free Anxiety App | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: MindShift CBT is a free anxiety app with CBT tools, thought journals, and coping strategies. Developed by Anxiety Canada. iOS & Android.

faqs.a: Yes. MindShift CBT is completely free with no subscriptions, ads, or in-app purchases. It's developed by Anxiety Canada, a non-profit organization, as a public resource.

faqs.q: What types of anxiety does MindShift CBT help with?
faqs.a: MindShift is designed for various anxiety types including generalized anxiety disorder, social anxiety, panic disorder, specific phobias, and performance anxiety. The CBT techniques apply broadly to anxious thinking.

faqs.q: Is MindShift CBT good for teens?
faqs.a: Yes. MindShift was originally designed with a youth-friendly approach and is appropriate for teens and young adults. The language and examples are accessible for younger users.

faqs.q: How is MindShift different from meditation apps?
faqs.a: MindShift focuses on CBT - changing how you think about anxiety - rather than meditation. It includes thought journals, belief experiments, and cognitive restructuring tools. If you want meditation, try Calm or Headspace alongside MindShift.

clinical_trials.study: MindShift CBT added to usual care vs usual care alone for anxiety in psychiatric inpatients (6 days)

citation.authors: Sharma G, Schlosser L, Jones BDM, Blumberger DM, Gratzer D, Husain MO, Mulsant BH, Rappaport L, Stergiopoulos V, Husain MI
citation.title: Brief App-Based Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Anxiety Symptoms in Psychiatric Inpatients: Feasibility Randomized Controlled Trial

clinical_trials.outcome: Feasible and acceptable; 20 randomized and 11 completed, too few to judge efficacy.

clinical_trials.study: 16-week open-label study of MindShift in adults in Canada and the US

citation.authors: Rappaport LM, Jerome E, Van Ameringen M, Whittal M, McLean CP
citation.title: North American open-label 16-week trial of the MindShift smartphone app for adult anxiety

clinical_trials.outcome: Anxiety (d = 0.61) and depression (d = 0.50) improved over 16 weeks; no control group. Authors volunteered on Anxiety Canada's scientific advisory committee; a 2024 corrigendum fixed a quality-of-life score.

primary_uses: Challenging anxious thoughts with a thought journal
Planning step-by-step exposure to feared situations
Coping statements and relaxation audio for anxious moments
Checking in on mood and anxiety

availability.note: Anxiety Canada closed on April 1, 2025; the app continues under 247 Labs Inc. Community forum is 18+.
